description: This file provides polyfill functions for PHP's ctype functions, enabling compatibility for PHP versions prior to 8.0 by conditionally requiring an appropriate bootstrap file or defining missing ctype functions that delegate to the Symfony polyfill classes.

classes.name: p\Ctype
classes.description: Namespace class providing static methods for ctype functions, part of the Symfony polyfill package.

methods.name: ctype_alnum
methods.description: Checks if the input string is alphanumeric, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_alnum.

methods.name: ctype_alpha
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only alphabetic characters, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_alpha.

methods.name: ctype_cntrl
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains control characters, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_cntrl.

methods.name: ctype_digit
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only digits, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_digit.

methods.name: ctype_graph
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains any visible characters, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_graph.

methods.name: ctype_lower
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only lowercase alphabetic characters, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_lower.

methods.name: ctype_print
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only printable characters, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_print.

methods.name: ctype_punct
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only punctuation characters, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_punct.

methods.name: ctype_space
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only whitespace characters, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_space.

methods.name: ctype_upper
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only uppercase alphabetic characters, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_upper.

methods.name: ctype_xdigit
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only hexadecimal digits, delegated to Symfony\Polyfill\Ctype::ctype_xdigit.
